candidate.definition_en: To put food into the mouth and chew and swallow it.
candidate.explanation_ar: يأكل: يضع الطعام في فمه ويمضغه ويبتلعه.

senses.definition_en: To put food into the mouth and chew and swallow it.
senses.explanation_ar: أن يضع الإنسان أو الحيوان الطعام في فمه ويمضغه ويبتلعه.

examples: I eat an apple every day.
Do you eat meat or are you vegetarian?
We usually eat dinner together as a family.
